name: orange22_statement_delivery_public_actor_v1
public_basis: 既有fresh公开读者提出的helper测试及数字/字符串逐位置还原关系；无源代码修复
run_note: 固定发布与派生镜像后，用已有r2e_probe_e2e.py --no-grade运行；绑定唯一label、未占用的18190–18199端口及当前作业槽。公开复现中的原缺陷失败单列，不当成基础设施失败。

steps.command:
id
pwd
python - <<'PYINFO'
import sys
import numpy
import Orange
from Orange.widgets.data import owcreateclass
print("interpreter", sys.executable)
print("python_version", sys.version.split()[0])
print("numpy", numpy.__version__, numpy.__file__)
print("Orange", Orange.__file__)
print("module", owcreateclass.__file__)
PYINFO

QT_QPA_PLATFORM=minimal xvfb-run --auto-servernum python - <<'PYCHECK'
import numpy as np
from Orange.widgets.data.owcreateclass import unique_in_order_mapping
for values in ([8, 4, 6, 8, 4], ["zebra", "apple", "zebra", "mint", "apple"]):
    a = np.asarray(values)
    unique, mapping = unique_in_order_mapping(a)
    print("input", a.tolist(), "unique", unique.tolist(), "mapping", mapping.tolist())
    assert np.array_equal(unique[mapping], a), "mapping must reconstruct the input"
PYCHECK
